rejected.title: D1 MCP OAuth manager (Cline McpHub pattern)
rejected.rejectionReason: Scope-confidence audit (2026-04-24): WogiFlow is not an MCP client (no @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dep; existing flow-mcp-* scripts are capability-discovery only). Cline McpHub pattern does not transfer — Claude Code is the MCP host. Claude Code 2.1+ native MCP OAuth already covers this. User chose option C: drop the story entirely.

rejected.title: D2 execpolicy-style declarative command policy
rejected.rejectionReason: Scope-confidence audit (2026-04-24): spec misframes WogiFlow as owner of Bash allow/deny wildcards — those belong to Claude Code (settings.local.json permissions.{allow,deny,ask}, enforced before any WogiFlow hook fires). WogiFlow Bash gates are content-aware (git-safety, deploy, strike, scope-mutation, commit-log) not wildcard lists. AC1/2/4/5 duplicate Claude Code native permission system. Only AC3 (per-phase overlay) was genuinely additive. User chose option A: drop the story entirely.

rejected.title: H2 Permission-ruleset-per-phase
rejected.rejectionReason: Scope-confidence audit batch scan (2026-04-24): same root cause as wf-ac2a8074 (D2). Claude Code owns .claude/settings.json permissions.{allow,deny,ask}, enforced before any WogiFlow hook fires. Phase-scoped permissions would require Claude Code itself to be phase-aware — out of WogiFlow scope. If surface-level per-phase restrictions are wanted, extend pre-tool-orchestrator with phase-scoped content-aware checks instead.
